actions.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect The steam mephit calls down a rain boiling water that surrounds them in a @Template[emanation|distance:10]. Creatures in the area take @Damage[2d8[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic|options:area-effect] save), and small unattended flames (such as torches) are extinguished.
actions.name: Boiling Rain

actions.description:
The steam mephit spits a cloud of steam in a @Template[cone|distance:15] that deals @Damage[2d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to each creature within the area (@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic|options:area-effect] save).

The steam mephit can't use Breath Weapon again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 rounds}.
actions.name: Breath Weapon
Fast Healing 2 (in boiling water or steam)

actions.description: The steam mephit ignores the Concealed condition from mist and steam.
actions.name: Steam Vision

name: Steam Mephit
publicNotes: These brash and arrogant creatures are among the more energetic mephits. They are quick to nominate themselves the leaders of any group, barking out orders in shrill, high-pitched voices and insisting on having everything done their way. Even when they aren't bossing others around, the constant hiss of steam escaping from their pores ensures that there is never a quiet moment.
